decisions.reason: It is a proven, strategically central product with named government adoption and broad APIS connectivity, so it remains a strong fit for our aviation and border-security portfolio.
Travel-health compliance has become a narrower need by 2025 and, while adjacent to our offer, it is less core and less defensible than our other passenger-processing and security products.
Cyber security awareness training fits our trainer-led model, serves growing customer demand, and scales well as a cross-sell across critical-infrastructure clients.
Behaviour analysis remains strategically relevant for high-risk environments, though we expect slower sales and closer customer scrutiny, so we will retain it but watch performance carefully.
Document verification is close to our core operational security services and complements our transport and border-related solutions with clear ongoing customer value.
